entities.title: Skilled Immigration Act - Opportunities for Skilled Workers
entities.summary: Germany's Skilled Immigration Act offers non-EU skilled workers, especially in IT, care and skilled craft sectors, various opportunities to come work in Germany. The visa application process has been simplified with online applications available via the Consular Services Portal.
application_process: Apply online for a German visa via the Consular Services Portal
Get professional qualifications recognised in Germany before applying for a visa
important_notes: Skilled workers from abroad must get their professional qualifications recognised in Germany in good time before they apply for a visa
